bench.rule: S032 §3 -- complete-session timing is not a promotion benchmark

claim_boundary: A complete 48-layer stateful Flash forward retained linear recurrent and full-attention KV state across multiple caller-supplied reference continuation tokens in one native process, checking each token against its preceding terminal argmax. Cross-species seams still use host diagnostic vectors; this does not prove source-independent NX, TPS, EBPW, capability, or HCLI residency.

execution.reference_contract: each caller-supplied continuation token is independently compared with the terminal argmax of its preceding exact 48-layer state
execution.state_reset_scope: linear species reset only before session token zero; full-attention KV buffers allocated once per layer and indexed by the advancing token position

next: Run clean repeated timing, then census state/dispatch/bytes-per-token before selecting the highest-value physical or representation optimization.
